पितामहः (ही f.)
1 A paternal
grandfather.
--2 An epithet of
Brahman.
--हाः (pl.) The Manes.

पितृ m. [पाति रक्षति, पा-तृच् नि˚]
1
A father; तेनास लोकः पितृमान् विनेत्रा

; 1. 24; 11. 67.
--रौ (dual)
Parents, father and mother; जगतः
पितरौ वंदे पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ

.
--रः (pl.) {1} Fore-fathers,
ancestors, fathers; Ś. 6. 24.
--2
Paternal ancestors taken
collectively;

.
--3 The Manes;

; 192.
--Comp.
--अर्जित a.
acquired by a father, paternal (as
[]
property.)
--कर्मन् n.,
--कार्यं, --कृत्यं,
क्रिया oblations or sacrifice offered to
deceased ancestors, obsequial rites:

.
--कल्पः performance of
the Śrāddha ceremony in honor of
the Manes.
--काननं a cemetery;

.
--कुल्या N. of a river
rising in the Malaya mountain.
--गणः {1} the whole body of
ancestors taken collectively. {2} a class
of Manes or deceased progenitors
who were sons of the Prajāpati;
see

-195.
--गणा N. of
Durgā.
--गातिन् a. devolving on,
or belonging to, a father.
--गृहं {1}
a paternal mansion. {2} a cemetery,
burial-ground.
--घातकः, घातिन् m.
a parricide.
--तर्पणं {1} an oblation to
the Manes. {2} the act of throwing
water out of the right hand (as at
the time of ablutions) as an
offering to the Manes or deceased
ancestors;

. {3} sesamum. {4}
gifts given at Śrāddhas or funeral
rites. {5} the part of the hand
between the thumb and the fore
finger (sacred to the Manes.).
--तिथिः f. the day of new-moon
(अमावास्य).
--तीर्थं {1} N. of the
place called Gayā where the
performance of funeral rites, such
as Śrāddhas in honour of the Manes,
is held to be particularly
meritorious. {2} the part of the hand be
tween the fore-finger and the thumb
(considered to be sacred to the
Manes).
--दत्त a. given by a father
(as a woman's peculiar property).
--दानं an offering to the Manes
--दायः patrimony.
--दिनं the day
of new-moon (अमावास्या).
--देव a
{1} worshipping a father. {2}
relating to the worship of the Manes
--(वाः) the divine Manes.
--देवत
a {1} presided over by the Manes.
{2} relating to the worship of the
Manes.
--(तं) N. of the tenth
lunar mansion (मघा).
--दैवत्य a.
belonging to the worship of the
Manes.
--(त्यं) a sacrifice offered
to the Manes on the day called
अष्टका.
--द्रव्यं patrimony;

.
--पक्षः {1} the paternal side,
paternal relationship. {2} a relative
by the father's side. {3} ‘the
fortnight of the Manes’, N of the dark
half of Bhādrapada which is
[]
particularly appointed for the
celebration of obsequial rites to the Manes.
--पतिः an epithet of Yama.
--पदं
the world of the Manes.
--पितृ m. a
paternal grandfather.
--पुत्रौ (
पितापुत्रौ dual) father and son. (पितुः
पुत्रः means ‘the son of a
wellknown and renowned father’).
--पूतनं worship of the Manes.
--पैतामह a. (हीं f.) inherited from
ancestors, ancestral, hereditary.
(--हाः pl.) ancestors.
--प्रसूः f. {1} a
paternal grandmother. {2} evening
twilight.
--प्राप्त a. {1} inherited from
a father. {2} inherited
patrimonially.
--बंधु a kinsman by the
father's side; they are:
--पितुः
पितुःस्वसुः पुत्राः पितुर्मार्तुःस्वसः सुताः ।
पितुर्मतुलपुत्रश्च विन्ज्ञेयाः पितृबंधवः ॥ (धु n.)
relationship by the father's side.
--भक्त a. dutifully attached to
a father.
--भक्तिः f. filial duty,
--भोजनं food offered to the
Manes.
--भ्रातृ m. a father's
brother, paternal uncle.
--मंदिरं {1}
a paternal mansion. {2} a cemetery.
--मेधः a sacrifice offered to the Manes,
obsequial offerings.
--यज्ञः {1}
obsequial offerings. {2} offering libations
of water every day to the deceased
ancestors; it is one of the five daily
Yajñas enjoined to be performed
by a Brāhmaṇa; पिमृयज्ञातु तर्पणं

; also 122, 283.
--यानं the
the way of the Manes (to their
world).
--राज् m.
--राजः, --राजन् m.
an epithet of Yama.
--रूपः an
epithet of Śiva.
--लोकः the world of
the Manes.
--वंशः the paternal
family.
--वनं a cemetery. (
पितृवनेचरः {1} a demon, goblin. {2} an
epithet of Śiva).
--वसतिः f.
--सद्मन्
n. a cemetery;

.
--व्रतः a
worshipper of the Manes.
--(तं)
obsequial rites
--श्राद्धं obsequial rites
in honour of a father or deceased
ancestor.
--स्वसृ f. (also पितृष्वसृ as
well as पितुः स्वसृ or पितुःष्वसृ) a father's
sister;

.
--ष्वसीयः a
paternal aunt's son.
--संनिभ a.
fatherly, paternal.
--सूः {1} a paternal
grandmother. {2} evening twilight,
--स्थानः, --स्थानीयः a guardian (who
is in the place of a father).
--हत्या
parricide.
--हन् m. a parricide.
--हू
m. the right ear; पितृहूर्दक्षिणः कर्ण
उत्तरो देवहूः स्मृतः.

पितृक a.
1 Paternal, ancestral,
hereditary.
--2 Obsequial.

पितृमत् a.
1 Having a father.
--2
Having an illustrious father.
--3
Accompanied by or connected with
the Manes.
--4 Mentioning the
Manes.

पितृवत् a. Having a father living.
--ind. Like a father or the Manes.

1 A father's brother,
paternal uncle.
--2 Any elderly male
relation:

पित्तं Bile, one of the three
humours of the body (the other two
being वात and कप). पित्तं यदि शर्करया
शाम्यति कोर्थः पटोलेन

.
--Comp.
--अती रः a bilious form
of diarrhœa.
--अभिष्यदः a bilious
form of ophthalmia.
--अरिः N. of
several plants लक्ष, वर्वर &c.
--उपहत
a. affected by bile; पश्यति पित्तोपहतः
शशिशुभ्रं शंखमपि पीतं K.

.
--कोषः the gall-bladder.
--क्षोभः excess
or derangement of the bilious
humour.
--गदिन् a. bilious, affected by
bile
--ज्वरः a bilious fever.
--प्रकृति
a. of a bilious or choleric
temperament.
--प्रकोपः excess and
vitiation of the bilious humour.
--रक्तं
plethora
--वायुः flatulence caused
by the excess and vitiation of the
bilious humour.
--विदग्ध a.
impaired by bile.
--शमन, --हर a.
antibilious.

पित्तल a. Bilious.
--लं
1 Brass.
--2 A species of birch tree.

पीतल a. Yellow.
--लः The yellow
colour.
--लं Brass.

पित्र्य a. [पितुरिदं प्रियं वा पितृत आगतं
वा यत्]
1 Paternal, patrimonial,
ancestral.
--2 (a) Relating or sacred
to the deceased ancestors;
Ms. 2

59. (b) Obsequial.
--त्र्यः
1 The
eldest brother.
--2 The month of
Māgha.
--त्र्या
1 The constellation
called Maghā.
--2 The day of full
as well as new moon.
--त्र्यं
1 The
lunar mansion called Maghā.
--2
The part of the hand between the
fore-finger and the thumb (sacred
to the Manes).
पित्सत् m. A bird.
पित्सलः A road, path.

.

soaked in, filled or saturated with
--3 Absorbed, drunk up, evaporated;

.

. {2} an actor. {3} a
